values.binNote: HealingAmpForLowHealthAllies=0.5 is the 50% amplification multiplier applied to HealingCalc (1 + 0.5 = 1.5x), which is how the wiki's 1.5x/75% AP figures are derived; the row itself states 0.5 not 1.5 but AmpedHealing = HealingCalc * (1 + 0.5) matches the wiki's numbers.

mechanics.claim: Heals Soraka and all allied champions regardless of distance.
mechanics.quote: '''Soraka''' calls upon the stars, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and all allied champions, increased by 50% on targets

mechanics.claim: Healing is increased by 50% on allies below 40% of their maximum health.
mechanics.quote: increased by 50% on targets {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}

mechanics.claim: Effects occur before the cast time completes.
mechanics.quote: ''Wish's'' effects occur before the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Casting immediately upon respawning causes the heal to not be increased by AP, due to a bug.
mechanics.quote: casting ''Wish'' immediately upon respawning will cause its cooldown to be unaffected by ability haste, and the healing will not be increased by '''Soraka's''' {{as|ability power}}
